def collapse_whitespace(s):
    """Collapse runs of ASCII whitespace into single spaces and strip ends."""
    # Build translation table: replace all ASCII whitespace (space, tab, LF, CR, VT, FF) with space
    # ASCII whitespace codes: space(32), tab(9), LF(10), CR(13), VT(11), FF(12)
    _ascii_ws = bytes([9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32])  # tab, LF, VT, CR, FF, space
    _trans_table = bytes.maketrans(_ascii_ws, b' ' * len(_ascii_ws))

    # Encode to ASCII (spec guarantees input is ASCII-encoded code points)
    data = s.encode('ascii')

    # Strip leading/trailing ASCII whitespace
    data = data.strip(_ascii_ws)

    # Collapse runs of ASCII whitespace into single space
    data = data.translate(_trans_table).replace(b'  ', b' ')
    # Repeat collapse until no double spaces remain (handles 3+ consecutive)
    while b'  ' in data:
        data = data.replace(b'  ', b' ')

    # Decode back to string
    return data.decode('ascii')
